scope: exploratory zero-shot resource preflight, not whole-bank or independent performance confirmation
selection: first16 original-order N20 members in every case, no energy/resource/outcome selection
policy: use full Rustiq instead of native only if all3 metrics nonincreasing and one strict; adopt projected only if same dominance over this baseline; no native metric increase guaranteed
counter: unchanged paperstudy.lucj.circuit_views, all-to-all logical Z-sampling, same basis/optimization/seed for all3
projection: unchanged qualified fixed whole-network X/Y union, HF frozen occupations, FSWAP conjugation, no angle pruning
independent_verifier: all3 actual compiled sampling QPYs vs original sparse source; Aer0.18.0 MPS double, zero truncation threshold, no finite bond cap; contract norm and query ALL source support to include leakage
storage: one transactional SQLite with3 compressed actual QPYs and certificate per member; no statevectors/MPS saved
aggregation: within-prefix original member shot weights only, never imply whole783 bank mean
limitations: ideal sampling distribution not arbitrary input unitary or noisy channel
same-setup adaptation not original paper full reproduction
